flags.sourceSentence: Meridian may amend the Club Rules, the Schedule of Fees, the hours of operation, the class timetable and the terms of this Agreement at any time by posting the amended version at the club or on the Meridian website, and the amended version applies to you from the date it is posted.
flags.consequence: Meridian can change the dues, fees, rules, hours, and any term of the agreement unilaterally and immediately, and your continued use of the gym counts as acceptance — so the price and terms you signed are not fixed.

flags.sourceSentence: Meridian’s total liability to you for any claim arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or your use of any facility — whether the claim is framed in contract, in negligence or otherwise — will not exceed the total dues and fees you paid to Meridian in the twelve (12) months immediately before the event giving rise to the claim.
flags.consequence: If you are injured or your property is damaged, your recovery from Meridian is capped at one year's worth of dues and fees, and you cannot recover lost income, lost business opportunity or property left in a locker at all.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify, defend and hold harmless Meridian and its ofﬁcers, employees, instructors and contractors against any claim, demand, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable legal fees, that is brought by a third party and arises out of your use of the facilities, your conduct on club premises, the conduct of a guest you bring, or any service you provide to another member.
flags.consequence: You could be on the hook for a third party's claim, legal fees, and defense costs arising from ordinary use of the gym, a guest's conduct, or helping another member — with Meridian choosing the lawyer and blocking any settlement you might prefer.

flags.sourceSentence: For twelve (12) months after your Program candidacy ends for any reason, you will not teach, coach or deliver group ﬁtness instruction or personal training, whether as an employee, as a contractor or on your own account, at any facility within ﬁfteen (15) miles of a Meridian location at which you taught or trained.
flags.consequence: If you join the instructor program, you could be barred from teaching or coaching group fitness or personal training anywhere within 15 miles of any Meridian location where you taught or trained for a full year after your candidacy ends — for any reason, including Meridian ending it — and you cannot solicit members for outside instruction.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute, claim or controversy between you and Meridian arising out of or relating to this Agreement, your membership or the Program will be resolved by ﬁnal and binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer arbitration rules, and you and Meridian each waive any right to a trial by jury and any right to bring or participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: You give up your right to a jury trial and to join a class action against Meridian; serious disputes would go to a single arbitrator whose award is final, with only a 30-day window after signing to opt out.

flags.sourceSentence: Access is by keycard or through the application, and you are responsible for every entry made with your keycard or your account.
flags.consequence: You are on the hook for every entry made with your keycard or account, and you must report any change to your contact, billing or emergency-contact details in writing within 10 days or risk the consequences of missed notices.

flags.sourceSentence: You authorise Meridian to draw all dues, tuition and charges from the payment method on your account until this Agreement has ended and your balance is nil.
flags.consequence: You authorize ongoing automatic withdrawals from your payment method for all dues, tuition, and charges until the agreement ends and your balance is zero, including any charges under a fee schedule Meridian can revise by posting.

flags.sourceSentence: You may end your Program enrolment by notifying the Program ofﬁce in writing at least ninety (90) days before the anniversary date, in which case no further tuition is charged and your candidacy closes at the end of the Program year then running.
flags.consequence: Program tuition renews automatically each year at the then-current rate, and you must give written notice at least 90 days before the anniversary to stop it; missing the window means another year of tuition.

flags.sourceSentence: Candidates are expected to complete sixty (60) supervised teaching hours in each Program year, and a candidate who falls short may be held back a year at Meridian’s discretion.
flags.consequence: If you fall short of 60 supervised teaching hours in a Program year, Meridian can hold your candidacy back a year at its sole discretion, extending your time in the Program and your exposure to its renewal and post-termination terms.

flags.sourceSentence: On an annual plan the deadline to cancel is the day that falls thirty (30) days before the anniversary of the date you first subscribed, and where no cancellation is received by that day the term extends by a further twelve (12) months at the annual fee then in effect.
flags.consequence: On an annual plan, missing the cancellation deadline locks the signer into a further twelve months at the then-current annual fee, and a fee already collected for a Billing Period is not refunded.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Northwind harmless from any claim brought by a third party that relates to content you uploaded, exported or published through the service, including a claim that the content infringes a copyright, a trade mark or a right of privacy, and you will pay our reasonable legal costs of defending such a claim.
flags.consequence: The signer must pay Northwind's reasonable legal costs and any damages arising from a third-party claim that content they uploaded, exported or published infringes a copyright, trade mark or privacy right — an open-ended obligation with no dollar cap.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between you and Northwind arising out of these terms or out of your use of the service will be settled by binding arbitration before a single arbitrator under the consumer rules of a recognised arbitration body, and you agree to bring any claim only in your individual capacity and not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to sue in court or join a class action against Northwind; every dispute must go to binding arbitration before a single arbitrator, whose award is final, with only small claims court preserved for individual claims that qualify.

flags.sourceSentence: We may revise the fee for any plan, and a revised fee applies to you from the start of the first Billing Period that begins more than thirty (30) days after we send notice of the revision to the email address on your account.
flags.consequence: Northwind can raise the subscription fee on any plan with only thirty (30) days' email notice, and the signer either pays the higher fee or must cancel.

flags.sourceSentence: A cancellation made on or after the first day of a Billing Period takes effect at the end of that Billing Period, and the fee already collected for it is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels on or after the first day of a Billing Period, the cancellation only takes effect at the end of that period and the fee already collected is not refunded; closing the account mid-period likewise forfeits the current period's fee.

flags.sourceSentence: We may amend these terms, the pricing page and the Fee Schedule at any time, an amended version takes effect when we post it at northwindstudio.example/terms, and your continued use of the service after it is posted is your acceptance of the amended version.
flags.consequence: Northwind can change the fees, the terms and the Fee Schedule at any time, and the signer is bound by the amended version simply by continuing to use the service after it is posted — with no consent required.

flags.sourceSentence: Northwind’s aggregate liability to you for every claim relating to the service, whether framed in contract, in tort, in warranty or otherwise — and including any claim arising from lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — will not exceed the amount you actually paid us under Section 2 for the Billing Period in which the claim arose.
flags.consequence: Northwind's total liability for anything going wrong — including lost work, lost revenue or a failed export — is limited to the amount the signer paid for the single Billing Period in which the claim arose, which could be one month's fee.

flags.sourceSentence: You may not share your credentials with anyone else, and an account we believe is being used by more than one person may be suspended while we ask you about it.
flags.consequence: Northwind can suspend the signer's account, without prior notice, whenever it believes more than one person is using the credentials — interrupting access to work and exports.

flags.sourceSentence: For a period of twelve (12) months following the last day of your employment, whether that employment ends at your choice or at ours, you will not provide services that are the same as or substantially similar to those you provided to Ardent, whether as an employee, a consultant, a contractor, an adviser or a principal, to any business that develops, manufactures or sells a product within the Restricted Field as that term is defined in Exhibit B to this letter.
flags.consequence: For 12 months after employment ends — even if Ardent ends it without cause — the signer cannot work in a similar role for any business in the Restricted Field defined in Exhibit B, which could block their primary source of income in their specialised field.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify Ardent and hold it harmless against any claim, loss, liability or expense, including reasonable attorney fees, that arises out of a breach by you of Section 4 or Section 5 of this letter, or out of a claim by a former employer that your employment with Ardent breaches an obligation you owe to them.
flags.consequence: The signer must personally pay Ardent's claims, losses, and attorney fees arising from a breach of the confidentiality or non-compete sections, or even from a former employer merely claiming the new job breaches an old obligation — regardless of whether that claim succeeds.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Ardent each agree that any claim arising out of or relating to your employment, its terms, or its end, including any statutory claim, will be resolved by final and binding arbitration administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised arbitration provider, on an individual basis only, and each of us waives any right to a jury trial and any right to participate in a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up their right to a jury trial and to join any class, collective, or representative action, and must pursue any employment-related claim — including statutory claims — alone in individual arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: If you resign or are terminated for cause within twelve (12) months of your start date, the full signing payment becomes repayable within thirty days of your last working day.
flags.consequence: The signer must repay the entire $15,000 signing payment within 30 days of their last working day if they resign or are fired for cause within the first 12 months — even if they leave for a better opportunity or the role proves unsuitable.

flags.sourceSentence: Ardent may introduce, withdraw, interpret or amend any policy, handbook provision, benefit plan or term of employment described in this letter at any time and without your agreement, and the version in force on the Ardent intranet governs from the date it is published there.
flags.consequence: Ardent can change or withdraw any term of the job — including benefits and policies — at any time without the signer's agreement, so the compensation and benefits described in the offer are not locked in.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator's total liability to the Occupant for any loss of or damage to stored property, however caused, including loss or damage caused by the Operator's own negligence, is limited to five thousand dollars ($5,000) unless the Occupant has declared a higher value on the Unit Schedule and paid the corresponding value protection fee.
flags.consequence: If the occupant's stored property is lost or damaged — even where the Operator was negligent — recovery is capped at $5,000, so goods worth more than that are effectively uninsured by the Operator unless a higher value was declared and a fee paid.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant will indemnify, defend and hold the Operator harmless from every claim, demand, loss, cost and expense, including reasonable attorney fees, brought by any person and arising out of the Occupant's use of the unit or the premises, the property stored in the unit, or the acts of anyone the Occupant allows on to the premises.
flags.consequence: The occupant must cover the Operator's legal costs and damages if anyone sues the Operator over anything connected to the occupant's unit use, stored property, or guests — an open-ended obligation with no cap, which could exceed the value of the goods stored.

flags.sourceSentence: Where rent or any charge is unpaid, the Operator has a lien on all property stored in the unit and may deny the Occupant access, overlock the unit, and after the notice period the law requires, sell the contents and apply the proceeds to what is owed.
flags.consequence: If the unit is overlocked for unpaid rent or charges, the Operator can deny access and, after the legally required notice period, sell the occupant's stored belongings and keep the proceeds to cover what is owed — meaning a late payment could ultimately cost the occupant their goods.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may increase the monthly rent on not less than thirty (30) days written notice to the Occupant, and the increased rent is due on the first rent day falling after the notice period ends.
flags.consequence: The Operator can raise the monthly rent on 30 days' written notice with no cap on the increase, and the occupant's only alternative is to end the agreement and move their belongings.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent not received by the sixth day of the month incurs the late charge shown in the Schedule of Charges posted in the ofﬁce and on the Harbour Road website, and each further notice the Operator is required to send about an unpaid balance incurs the administration charge shown in the same schedule.
flags.consequence: Late payment triggers a late charge plus a separate administration charge for every notice the Operator sends about the unpaid balance, so repeated notices can stack multiple fees on top of the late charge and the underlying rent.

flags.sourceSentence: The Occupant is required to keep insurance on the stored property for its full value and to produce evidence of it on request.
flags.consequence: The occupant must maintain full-value insurance on everything stored and show proof on demand; without it, they bear the entire risk of loss themselves, and any claim above the Operator's liability cap would fall entirely on the occupant's own policy or pocket.

flags.sourceSentence: Gate hours, the rules posted in the office, and the terms of this Agreement may be changed by the Operator on notice posted at the facility and sent to the Occupant's last known email address, and the changed version applies to the Occupant from the first day of the month after it is posted.
flags.consequence: The Operator can change the agreement's terms, gate hours, and posted rules unilaterally by email or a facility notice, and the changes bind the occupant from the first day of the following month — so terms the occupant agreed to can be replaced without their consent.

flags.sourceSentence: Rent already paid for the month in which the Occupant moves out is not refunded.
flags.consequence: If the occupant moves out mid-month, the entire month's rent is forfeited even for the unused portion, on top of the requirement to give 10 days' notice and leave the unit swept clean.

flags.sourceSentence: The Operator may enter the unit to inspect it, to repair the premises, or where the Operator reasonably believes the contents present a danger, and will leave notice of the entry in or on the unit.
flags.consequence: The Operator can enter the occupant's unit without advance notice — leaving only a note after the fact — whenever it decides inspection, repair, or a perceived danger justifies entry, so stored belongings are not private from the Operator.

flags.sourceSentence: Cancelling a promotional plan before the end of its term does not cancel a device instalment plan, and the unpaid instalment balance becomes due in full on your next bill.
flags.consequence: If the signer cancels a twelve-month promotional plan before its term ends, any remaining device instalment balance becomes immediately due in full on the next bill, which could be a large lump-sum charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade’s entire liability to you for any claim relating to the service, a device, or this Agreement, whether the claim is made in contract, in negligence, in warranty or under any statute, is limited to the service charges applied to the affected line during the bill period in which the claim arose, and Cascade is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or any indirect or consequential loss.
flags.consequence: Cascade's total liability for any claim — including negligence — is capped at one bill period's service charges on the affected line, and it excludes lost profits, lost data, and indirect or consequential losses, so a serious service failure could leave the signer with minimal recovery.

flags.sourceSentence: You will indemnify and hold Cascade harmless from any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal fees, arising out of your use of the service, out of anything sent from or stored on your device, out of the use of your line by anyone you allow to use it, and out of any charge incurred on your account.
flags.consequence: The signer must cover Cascade's claims, losses, and legal fees arising from use of the service, anything sent or stored on the device, use of the line by anyone the signer allows, and any charge incurred on the account — potentially an open-ended obligation.

flags.sourceSentence: You and Cascade agree that any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the service or any device will be resolved by individual binding arbitration administered by a nationally recognised arbitration provider under its consumer rules, and both of us give up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective or representative action.
flags.consequence: The signer gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class, collective, or representative action, and must resolve any dispute in individual binding arbitration — removing court and class-action routes for serious problems such as systemic billing errors.

flags.sourceSentence: Your bill includes a Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and an Administrative Charge, neither of which is a tax or a charge required by any government, and Cascade may introduce, increase or remove either charge on notice given with the bill in which the change ﬁrst appears.
flags.consequence: The Regulatory Cost Recovery Charge and Administrative Charge are not government-required, and Cascade can introduce, increase, or remove them on notice given with the bill in which the change first appears, so the effective monthly cost can rise with little advance warning.

flags.sourceSentence: An amount not paid by the due date shown on the bill incurs a late payment charge of the greater of five dollars ($5.00) or one and one half percent of the unpaid balance, applied each bill period until the balance is paid, and a restored line incurs the restoral charge shown in the Rate and Charge Guide.
flags.consequence: Late payments accrue a charge of the greater of $5.00 or 1.5% of the unpaid balance each bill period until paid, and restoring a suspended line incurs an additional restoral charge.

flags.sourceSentence: Cascade may change any term of this Agreement, any charge, and any feature of your rate plan, and the change takes effect on the date stated in the notice we give you, which may be given on a bill, by message to your device, or by email.
flags.consequence: Cascade can change any term, charge, or rate plan feature on notice, and continued use of the service after the effective date counts as accepting the change, so the signer could face higher or new charges simply by keeping the service on.

flags.sourceSentence: Data speeds on an unlimited plan may be reduced after you use the monthly priority allowance shown on your Service Summary, and reduced speeds continue until the next bill period starts.
flags.consequence: Data speeds on an unlimited plan may be reduced after the monthly priority allowance is used, with reduced speeds continuing until the next bill period starts, so the signer may experience much slower service despite paying for an unlimited plan.

flags.sourceSentence: Charges accrue to the end of the bill period in which you cancel, and a part bill period is not prorated.
flags.consequence: When the signer cancels, charges accrue to the end of the bill period and the partial period is not prorated, so the signer pays for up to a full billing cycle they do not use.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may end the Programme early for any reason on one week written notice.
flags.consequence: The Firm can end the twelve-week Programme early for any reason on one week's written notice, cutting off the remaining stipend weeks with no compensation.

flags.sourceSentence: The Firm may amend the Programme Handbook, the assessment structure, the teaching schedule and the terms of this Agreement at any time by issuing a revised version to the Analyst by email, and the revised version applies from the date of that email.
flags.consequence: The Firm can unilaterally change the Handbook, assessments, teaching schedule and even the terms of this Agreement itself, effective immediately by email — including terms that could reduce pay or add obligations mid-programme.

flags.sourceSentence: For six (6) months after the Programme ends, the Analyst will not accept an engagement, whether paid or unpaid and whether as an employee, a contractor or an intern, with any firm on the Restricted List issued to the Analyst in week one of the Programme, and will not approach any client of the Firm whose file the Analyst worked on.
flags.consequence: For six months after the Programme, the Analyst cannot take any engagement — paid or unpaid, employee, contractor or intern — with any firm on the Restricted List, and cannot approach clients whose files they worked on, limiting their job options right after the programme.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will indemnify the Firm and hold it harmless against any claim, loss or expense, including reasonable legal costs, arising out of a breach by the Analyst of Section 4 or Section 5, or out of anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or a client of the Firm.
flags.consequence: The Analyst must personally pay the Firm for any claim, loss or expense — including the Firm's legal costs — arising from a breach of confidentiality or the post-programme restrictions, or from anything the Analyst publishes about the Firm or its clients, which is open-ended in amount.

flags.sourceSentence: Any dispute between the Analyst and the Firm arising out of the Programme or out of this Agreement will be resolved by final and binding arbitration on an individual basis, administered under the employment rules of a nationally recognised provider, and the Analyst gives up any right to a jury trial and any right to bring or join a class or collective action.
flags.consequence: The Analyst gives up the right to a jury trial and the right to bring or join a class or collective action, so any dispute — including over unpaid stipend or the indemnity — must be pursued as an individual arbitration.

flags.sourceSentence: Where the Analyst takes the optional housing advance, it is repaid in six equal instalments deducted from the stipend, and any instalment not recovered within ten (10) days of its due date carries the late charge set out in the Programme Handbook until it is repaid in full.
flags.consequence: A late housing-advance instalment accrues an open-ended late charge, set in the Handbook, every ten days until the advance is fully repaid, deducted from the weekly stipend.

flags.sourceSentence: The Analyst will keep confidential every client name, model, memorandum and data set the Analyst sees during the Programme, and will not retain a copy of any of it after the Programme ends. This obligation has no end date.
flags.consequence: The confidentiality obligation never expires — the Analyst must keep client names, models, memoranda and data confidential indefinitely and cannot retain any copies, which could complicate future work using general skills or knowledge gained.

flags.sourceSentence: An item not returned within five working days is charged at the replacement cost shown in the Programme Handbook.
flags.consequence: The Analyst is charged the Handbook's replacement cost for any issued item — laptop, security token or building pass — not returned within five working days of the last day of the Programme.

flags.sourceSentence: After the third lesson no refund is made.
flags.consequence: After the third lesson of the session, the entire $120 fee is forfeited — no refund is made even if the child attends no further lessons.

flags.sourceSentence: A place given up later than that, and before the third lesson, is refunded at half the fee.
flags.consequence: A withdrawal between the booking date and the third lesson — other than more than seven days before the first lesson — costs the family $60, half the fee, regardless of how many lessons the child actually attends.

flags.sourceSentence: A lesson missed for illness may be made up in another class at the same level during the same session, where a place is free.
flags.consequence: A missed lesson may go uncompensated: the make-up exists only if another class at the same level happens to have a free place, and no refund is offered when it does not.
